items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Ken [Bloods] who was the manager of the Regal Theatre in Chicago was a very good friend of Lionel Hampton's.

ctx.x: I was there for 5 months. We worked in the Rum Boogie. Ken [Bloods] who was the manager of the

Regal Theatre in Chicago was a very good friend of Lionel Hampton's. Lionel had called him -- well, see, Lionel had asked me in Houston to join his band, and I just got married during that time in the year of 1939, and he wanted to hear me play without a microphone, "Body and Soul" -- he said he heard about my big horn, as he said.
